content_en.prompt: You deliver packages starting at place A, delivering to all 7 other places, ending your job at the last place — never visiting the same place twice. Your employer pays for the total trip length; the map shows each path's length.
content_en.question: What is the length of the trip with the largest total length that your employer will pay for?
content_en.explanation: There are only 4 valid trips (visiting each place exactly once), with lengths 22, 23, 24, and 25 km. The longest, at 25 km, is the correct answer.
content_en.ct_explanation: This asks for a Hamiltonian path (visiting every node exactly once) with maximum total edge weight — a graph problem. Finding a Hamiltonian path (or even checking if one exists) is NP-complete; finding the maximum-weight one is even harder. A naive greedy approach (always pick the longest available edge first) actually fails here, since it can block the ability to visit every place exactly once.

content_zh.prompt: 你要從A地出發送包裹，送到其他7個地點各一個包裹，工作在最後一個地點結束——而且不能重複經過同一個地點。雇主會依照你走的總路程長度付你薪水，地圖上標出了每段路徑的長度。
content_zh.question: 在雇主願意支付的所有走法裡，最長的總路程是多少？
content_zh.explanation: 符合條件（每個地點恰好經過一次）的走法只有4種，總長度分別是22、23、24、25公里。其中最長的25公里就是正確答案。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這一題要找的是一條「總長度最大」的漢彌爾頓路徑（每個節點恰好經過一次的路徑）——是圖論裡的經典問題。要找出漢彌爾頓路徑（甚至只是判斷它存不存在）就已經是NP-complete等級的難題了，要再找出「總長度最大」的那條更是難上加難。如果單純用「每次都選最長的一段路」這種貪婪策略，反而會導致無法走遍所有地點。
